status: VERIFIED FROZEN RULES + ORIGINAL setuplab.trigger / EXPLORATORY FULL-UNIVERSE STUDY
caveats: All stocks and all dates are hypothetical D0 watches; NO BigMove model selection
Each setup is tested separately. First-wins selects earliest settled setup; same-day tie uses JSON setup order as SHADOW research convention (not a Tree rule).

Unique-event dedup uses nearest D0; independent setup events by symbol+setup+entry, first-wins by symbol+entry. D0 SDE depends on hypothetical watch date; signal-close SDE is unambiguous for a shared entry event.
S1 ATR is full-history 14-period SIMPLE TR divided by D0 close, matching setuplab.atr_simple; not Wilder ATR.
setuplab.trigger stops a D0/setup if a missing needed feature cannot be ruled out by a false condition.
No simultaneous-position capital limit, market impact/circuit fill certainty, or independent OOS test.
No slippage beyond frozen 35bp assumption; split/merger adjusted OHLCV and historic NSE universe remain inputs' responsibility.
D1 baseline same-exit comparison is required for N1, whose fresh exit is later than D5.
